name: Village and coastal cottage construction family

variants.note: Warm plaster facade with thick recessed door/window frames and a layered slate or thatched roof over short eaves.
Weathered timber facade with visible structural posts, lighter infill and a roof volume distinct from the wall plane.
Limewashed coastal walls, practical shutters and salt-darkened lower masonry; use coastal materials rather than a global blue tint.
Working island packing shed with a broader goods opening and open loading apron; review its civic/wide-door envelope separately from cottage parts.

approval.note: W0 catalogue proposal for Claude review; not drawable approval, not placeable.

requires.note: Proposed selector/relation for review; its exact matching contract must be added to W5 before promotion.

story.lore: Share roof, door and wall construction while preserving each household facade as its own assembly.

todo: Scope: shared. Reusable across the listed places; preserve site-specific assembly and state.
Purpose: Share roof, door and wall construction while preserving each household facade as its own assembly.

Visual brief: Thick plaster or timber walls, clear door recess, layered slate/thatched roof and short eaves; coastal versions have limewash and shutters, not a universal blue recolour. Window light sits behind the frame.
Geometry: proposed visual envelope only; Claude supplies exact foot, solid footprint, overhang, interaction anchors and any deck after review.
Implementation: concept only, outside the live piece library. Do not place, bake or grant gameplay until reviewed and approved.
Size: cottage 200-340 art px high, 192-340 wide; the packing shed must be reviewed against civic/wide_door rather than stretched from a cottage.
Reuse crossroads_north_cottages, crossroads_fern_cottage, crossroads_bakery and crossroads_hut for their named sites; do not flatten household differences.
Lighting: upper-left key light; shade each material and facing for that light. The lit-picture reference is deferred until art exists.
Size-class scope: cottage and the nominal geometry apply to a cottage body only. The packing-shed variant requires its own civic/wide_door approval before promotion.
